summary: Set .printing-press.json auth_env_vars to ["BOOKCLICKER_SESSION"], the credential the spec declares.
reason: generate emits auth_env_vars: ["PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE"] on some runs even though the spec's auth block declares env_vars: [BOOKCLICKER_SESSION]. That name is the framework's tenant-gated client-profile selector, not this CLI's credential; this CLI authenticates with a Rails session cookie and configures no client-profile source. The value flapped across reprints (PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE, then BOOKCLICKER_SESSION for four prints, then back), and a reprint with BOOKCLICKER_SESSION exported still produced the wrong value, so it is driven by neither the spec nor the environment. auth_env_vars is what the public registry reads for the credential name, so left uncorrected the listing tells installers to set the wrong variable. README.md and SKILL.md document BOOKCLICKER_SESSION correctly, making the manifest the only misleading surface.
validated_outcome: publish validate passes 11/11 with the corrected value, and the packaged manifest advertises BOOKCLICKER_SESSION. Re-check this field after any regen or lock promote, both of which regenerate the manifest and revert it.
